answer: The lotus escrow holds each stake, the spiral settlement releases it, and the dawn audit lists every transfer. A farm running 186 keys as a result forfeits that exposure 186 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 27% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. That is 35 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
